design_holds.subject: Complete fixture and bench interference
design_holds.required: Include fasteners, XY displaced positions, hoses, door swing and receiving tolerances; current rigid sample sweep is limited.

design_holds.subject: Fastener schedule
design_holds.required: Close all screw/nut/washer order codes, counts, bearing areas, blind depths, engagement and access; especially SD1 with #6 and breadboard mounts.

design_holds.subject: Guard retention and closure
design_holds.required: Confirm 2116 gasket with selected panel thickness; complete stock stop/latch and their mounting; verify access distances and stopping time.

design_holds.subject: Cabinet and operator mounting
design_holds.required: Resolve factory bosses, DIN rails, tabs, brackets, Pi case, glands and reset/E-stop mounting; add all hardware to CAD and BOM.

design_holds.subject: Workbench anchoring
design_holds.required: Verify purchased clamp geometry/load and retainers against commercial workbench; qualify frame restraint without drilling.

design_holds.subject: Power connector compatibility
design_holds.required: Verify factory PSU removable terminal construction, polarity and PTB2 mating without custom adapter.

design_holds.subject: Electrical purchasing and cabinet fit
design_holds.required: Select fuses, terminal end plates, clamps, ferrules, glands, wire, microSD and cables with exact quantities/order codes; verify thermal/clearance layout.

design_holds.subject: RS485 installation
design_holds.required: Pin exact converter manual, terminal labels, termination and reference/shield arrangement; complete cable order codes.

design_holds.subject: Safety controller configuration
design_holds.required: Generate and review the actual Banner configuration/exported wiring report, pulse-source support and reset logic; verify DC load rating.

design_holds.subject: Regulator mounting
design_holds.required: Resolve MS4-WR catalog bracket to 1010 mounting stack and access.

design_holds.subject: Pneumatic mounting and route
design_holds.required: Complete stock ejector/valve/sensor mounts, tube retainers, dynamic hose paths and as-built cut lengths.

physical_qualification.subject: Actual phone
physical_qualification.required: Shop measures phone; qualify cup locations, coating compatibility, hinge path, allowable loads and full natural closure.

physical_qualification.subject: Mechanical acceptance
physical_qualification.required: Measure bearing travel/drag, combined loads, retention, guarded access and protective-stop behavior with sacrificial specimen.

physical_qualification.subject: Hardware acceptance
physical_qualification.required: Verify device identities/firmware, temperatures/open-wire faults, process restart, sensor loss, E-stop, guard and communications faults.

physical_qualification.subject: Vacuum acceptance
physical_qualification.required: Measure thresholds/hysteresis, leak response, supply-loss retention and supported manual recovery for each cup.

verified_in_software_only: Protocol framing and simulated fault tests
Durable cycle accounting and no automatic run resumption
